method: For each declared fine-anatomy target, select only its exact pinned Allen annotation value on each sampled native transverse plane, split the mask with deterministic 4-neighbour connectivity, and trace the exact pixel-edge rings of every component. Full-volume voxel counts are retained only to distinguish sampled-plane absence from source-label absence. No descendants, components, planes, or structures are joined, interpolated, smoothed, or hand drawn. Native-resolution RGBA overlays separately preserve the exact source pixels for the 37-label fine lane plus IDs 16/65/70 and for the off-by-default motor-context IDs 28-60.
